components.name: Zendesk Sidebar Application Host
components.purpose: Hosts the Zendesk embedded sidebar web interface for support agents.
components.rationale: Azure Static Web Apps provides automated, fast global hosting for custom front-end extensions.
trade_offs: Requires client-side token handling for authentication with backend.
components.security_considerations: Authenticates requests using signed JWT tokens issued by Zendesk.

components.name: Core Agent Assist Backend Service
components.purpose: Processes incoming ticket requests, redacts PII, and orchestrates AI retrieval and drafting.
components.rationale: Azure Container Apps provides serverless container execution with dynamic autoscaling based on HTTP load.
trade_offs: Cold starts can introduce minor latency during initial request bursts.
components.security_considerations: Runs within an isolated virtual network subnet with no public IP exposure.

components.name: Integration API Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes and secures REST endpoints connecting Zendesk and the sidebar interface to backend services.
components.rationale: Azure API Management delivers centralized rate limiting, authentication, and policy enforcement.
trade_offs: Adds fixed infrastructure cost for dedicated gateway instances.
components.security_considerations: Enforces OAuth 2.0 token validation and TLS encryption on all endpoints.

components.name: Operational Relational Database
components.purpose: Stores 24-month source attribution audit records, evaluation dataset scores, and system configuration.
components.rationale: Azure SQL Database offers managed relational storage with point-in-time recovery and EU regional residency.
trade_offs: Requires continuous indexing management for large audit log volumes over 24 months.
components.security_considerations: Data is encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys and accessible only via Private Link.

components.validation_reason: Relies on pending assumption ASM_03 regarding Zendesk OAuth authentication.
components.name: Enterprise Identity Service
components.purpose: Manages identity authentication and role-based access control for administrative users and services.
components.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID integrates natively with Azure services for seamless identity and token verification.
trade_offs: External identity federation requires sync configuration with client enterprise identity providers.
components.security_considerations: Enforces conditional access policies and multi-factor authentication for administrative users.

components.name: Ingestion Event Bus
components.purpose: Routes bi-weekly documentation updates and sync triggers to background ingestion pipelines.
components.rationale: Azure Event Grid provides scalable, push-based event routing with guaranteed delivery mechanics.
trade_offs: Event delivery ordering is not strictly guaranteed across distinct topic channels.
components.security_considerations: Event publishers must authenticate using Azure Entra ID or dedicated SAS tokens.

components.name: Multi-Source Data Ingestion Orchestrator
components.purpose: Orchestrates scheduled extraction from Confluence, GitHub, SharePoint, and Zendesk into search indexes.
components.rationale: Azure Data Factory provides native connectors and managed pipeline orchestration for scheduled data synchronization.
trade_offs: Custom connector logic is required for non-standard API endpoints.
components.security_considerations: Authenticates to external repositories via secrets retrieved dynamically from Key Vault.

components.name: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
components.purpose: Indexes knowledge documentation and historical tickets to enable semantic and keyword hybrid retrieval.
components.rationale: Azure AI Search supports hybrid vector search, scoring profiles, and metadata filtering for deprecation handling.
trade_offs: Re-indexing large historical datasets requires dedicated search capacity allocation.
components.security_considerations: Restricts index access via managed identities and resides within the EU data boundary.

components.name: EU-Resident Foundation Language Models
components.purpose: Executes ticket classification, SLA priority recommendations, and grounded reply generation.
components.rationale: Foundry Models provides EU-hosted LLMs with strict contractual non-training guarantees.
trade_offs: Model throughput limits require quota management during peak daily ticket volumes.
components.security_considerations: Deployed exclusively in EU Azure regions with prompt logging disabled at the provider level.

components.name: PII Redaction and Content Safety Filter
components.purpose: Detects and redacts personal data, pasted credentials, and internal hostnames prior to model invocation.
components.rationale: Azure AI Content Safety provides pattern matching and entity detection to enforce data privacy guardrails.
trade_offs: Slight processing latency overhead added to the overall prompt preparation pipeline.
components.security_considerations: Operates inline before model calls and outputs verifiable redaction audit logs.

components.name: Application Telemetry and Monitoring
components.purpose: Monitors application performance, generation latencies, error traces, and system health.
components.rationale: Application Insights offers deep integration with Azure Container Apps for distributed tracing.
trade_offs: High log ingestion volume can increase monthly telemetry storage costs.
components.security_considerations: Automatically strips sensitive payload fields before writing diagnostic logs to disk.

components.name: Secrets and Cryptographic Key Management
components.purpose: Manages API tokens, database connection strings, and encryption keys securely.
components.rationale: Azure Key Vault provides secure key management backed by Hardware Security Modules.
trade_offs: Requires managed identity configuration across all consuming microservices.
components.security_considerations: Access is controlled via Azure RBAC with private endpoint network isolation.

components.name: Container Image Registry
components.purpose: Stores and scans container images used for backend microservices deployment.
components.rationale: Azure Container Registry offers secure container hosting with integrated vulnerability scanning.
trade_offs: Requires retention policy configuration to clean up old image build tags.
components.security_considerations: Implements image signing and restricts pull access via private endpoints.

components.name: Centralized Infrastructure Configuration
components.purpose: Stores environment-specific settings, feature flags, and prompt template parameters.
components.rationale: Azure App Configuration provides centralized, dynamic configuration management across environments.
trade_offs: Configuration changes require strict change management to prevent runtime misconfiguration.
components.security_considerations: Encrypted at rest and accessible only via managed identity over private endpoints.

components.name: Application Gateway WAF
components.purpose: Filters web traffic and balances incoming HTTP loads across backend API instances.
components.rationale: Azure Application Gateway delivers integrated Web Application Firewall protection and auto-scaling.
trade_offs: Requires SSL certificate lifecycle management and WAF rule tuning.
components.security_considerations: Blocks OWASP top 10 threats and terminates TLS connections securely.

components.name: Automated Cloud Backup Manager
components.purpose: Automates daily backups and point-in-time recovery for relational databases and configuration state.
components.rationale: Azure Backup ensures compliant data protection strictly bound within EU cloud storage.
trade_offs: Backup retention schedules consume additional storage quota over time.
components.security_considerations: Protects backup snapshots with soft delete and immutable vault policies.

environments.dev: Isolated Azure resource group in EU region used for developer testing, automated unit tests, and feature validation.
environments.test: Staging environment mirroring production configuration for performance benchmark testing, evaluation framework execution, and integration verification.
environments.prod: Production environment deployed in EU region with high availability, full monitoring, automated backups, and strict security controls.

deployment_runtime.text: The runtime environment is built on Azure Container Apps and Azure Static Web Apps for simplified operational management. Infrastructure is provisioned using automated Bicep templates to meet the Q3 2026 delivery milestone.

availability_scalability.text: Azure Application Gateway and Container Apps provide auto-scaling to seamlessly handle peak workloads of 280 daily tickets. High availability is maintained across EU availability zones with dynamic backend horizontal scaling.

backup_dr.text: Azure Backup enforces automated daily snapshots and point-in-time recovery for audit databases within EU data centers. Immutable storage policies guarantee that 24-month attribution records are protected against accidental deletion.

observability.text: Application Insights captures trace logs, generation latency, and error rates to monitor AI output quality and performance. Operational dashboards provide visibility into ticket classification accuracy and system error governance.

security_controls.text: Pre-inference PII redaction is enforced via Azure AI Content Safety, while Azure Key Vault secures operational credentials. Data residency is strictly maintained within EU boundaries with zero model training on customer data.
